prompt:
Editorial architecture photograph of a vast, bright exhibition hall with tall plain white walls and a pale polished concrete floor, lit by crisp midday sunlight falling from a long skylight. Four huge flat sheets of transparent coloured glass hang from fine steel cables in a staggered row that steps toward the camera <glass_sheets>: a small sunflower yellow sheet farthest away, then an emerald green sheet twice its size, then a magenta sheet twice that size, then an enormous cobalt blue sheet nearest the camera at the right edge, each sheet exactly double the one before. Sunlight shines through the glass and lays sharp-edged, intensely saturated rectangles of yellow, green, magenta and cobalt light across the floor and up the white wall <light_shapes>; where two coloured shapes overlap they mix into a third colour. Deep, pure, poster-like colour, hard clean shadow edges, high clarity, no haze, no fog, no glow, no lens flare. The left third of the frame is quiet: open floor and white wall washed with soft coloured light and very little detail <quiet_zone>. No people, no furniture, no plants, no text, no signage, no logos, no screens or devices. Medium format camera, 35 mm equivalent lens at eye level, everything in sharp focus, fine film grain, calm and monumental.
